anomalies.observed: FCC1's HSE crystal HSE1 is connected to PE6 (pin 5) and PE7 (pin 37) instead of the dedicated HSE pins PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13). NAVC1's HSE crystal HSE2 is not connected to any NAVC1 pin at all; its pins are on nets HSE_IN_NAVC and HSE_OUT_NAVC which have no MCU nodes. NAVC1's PH0 and PH1 are instead tied to 2.2u capacitors to ground.
anomalies.expected: The 25 MHz HSE crystals should be connected between the PH0 and PH1 pins of each MCU, with appropriate load capacitors, as required by the STM32H753 and STM32F405 datasheets and the specification's 'HSE crystal (both MCUs)' entry.
